title: 電車と駅の風景
subject_en: Train and station illustrations, each ONE separate object or small scene centred in its cell; generic trains with no company marks, flat style Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 電車・ホーム・改札・車内の場面など、鉄道にまつわる素材12点です。通勤や旅行の案内、地域の資料に使えます。
